Scrubbing shifts pitch with faint tape hiss; pausing & skipping add a brief motor spin-down while steady playback stays pure.
When online track switching stalls, briefly flash 0.5s of soft vintage FM tuning static before the song enters.
Tracks accumulate subtle cardboard sleeve ring impressions around the album cover based on local play count.
Tilt the phone for subtle glass sheen on artwork; progress scrubbing ticks mechanically with brief release inertia.
Sung lyric lines drop along gravity, stack physically on top of the player controls and move with them; tilt or shake your phone to slide and bounce them.
